findings.text: the change updated _departure_word's own docstring but left the two surrounding comments on the superseded three-word contract: the fleet_transitions comment says 'failing both, the word is withdrawn' and 'a departure with no project at all still withdraws — the safe direction' at :8144-8152, and the _departure_recorded_run_ids docstring says 'unknown is answered by the withdrawal word' at :8037. Under the head code a departure with no project resolves to recorded is None and reads departed, so both comments now contradict the behaviour they annotate and mislead the next reader about the contract.

The manifest's lint delta (it states 10 baseline / 10 head) reads 12 baseline / 10 head under my ruff run over the four changed Python paths, so the 'adds no findings' claim holds while the exact base figure is one the manifest got slightly wrong.
